text:
Marta: FYI Valora (acct ACN-23) just told us their UX Insights team goes live this week and they need realtime session summarization + embeddings. Seen a qps jump from ~120 -> ~740 in last 24h :eyes:
Samir: whoa — that delta will chew through tokens. do we have per-route token breakdown or top callers?
Ellie: they sent a short sample payload in the onboarding form. pasting here:
```
client: valora
routes: [session_summarize, session_embed]
peak_rps: 12
avg_tokens_per_request: 900
typical_window: 1s bursts
```
Marta: thanks — customer also said procurement + renewal in ~6w, wants predictability on cost. they may push for Dedicated if we can't show a cheaper config.
Derek: short term we can add burst capacity and enable prefix KV caching for summarize route. long term Dedicated + auto-scaling policies for consistent latency. I can sketch node counts — need approval from finance for reserved commit.
Samir: tagging pricing: @Ellie can you run a quick cost estimate for: 1) Hosted with aggressive batching + caching 2) Dedicated (2x cards) with 99% latency SLO. include migration/runbook.
Ellie: on it. also recommend an enablement workshop for their devs (prompt best practices + streaming). I've got a 30m slot in my playbook. OnboardBot: scheduled Valora onboarding workshop for Tue 10:00 AM PST — invite sent. :calendar:
Marta: great. Derek — can you confirm whether we can support a temporary 3x burst for 72h to smooth onboarding spikes? QuotaBot: temporary-burst-request submitted (req id qb-4821) — awaiting infra approval.
Derek: yes we can, but need to change the routing policy to route summarize->low-latency pool; that'll increase cost but keeps p99 under 400ms. I'll prep a runbook and a short rollback plan.
Samir: also collecting feedback point: they reported higher variance on short sessions (10-60 tokens) vs long ones. may be batching misconfig. @Ellie can we add a quick eval set to regression alerts?
Ellie: will add an eval: 20 short sessions, 5 long sessions, baseline vs current model. I'll link the playbook and cost spreadsheet after I finish.
Marta: action items: 1) Ellie to deliver cost + playbook (ETA EOD tomorrow) 2) Derek to prep burst plan + runbook (ETA EOD today) 3) Samir to own renewal note and exec summary for sales. I'll follow up with Valora after the workshop.
Derek: noted. tagging infra on-call in the burst request. :thumbsup:
Marta: thanks team. keeping this as high priority — renewal watch.
